sloka: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो गुरु चित्त प्रसादक ।ह्रियमाणाम् न जानीषे रक्षसा काम रूपिणा ॥३-४९-२४॥
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho guru citta prasādaka ।hriyamāṇām na jānīṣe rakṣasā kāma rūpiṇā ॥3-49-24॥

translations.english: Alas, O longarmed Lakshmana, you who used to entertain your brother do not know that I am being carried away by this ruthless demon.
